question_text:
2. 
What will be the annual after-tax cash inflow from the further-processing proposal? 
(a) 
 ` 24,00,000 
(b)  
` 27,00,000 
(c)  
` 31,00,000 
(d)  
` 38,00,000
suggested_answer: (C) ` 31,00,000 Incremental Contribution Before Depreciation & Tax = ` 50,00,000 Less: Depreciation = ` 1,20,00,000 / 10 = ` 12,00,000 Profit Before Tax = 50,00,000 – 12,00,000 = ` 38,00,000 Less: Tax @ 50% = ` 19,00,000 Profit After Tax = ` 19,00,000 Add Back Depreciation = 19,00,000 + 12,00,000 = ` 31,00,000
